descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S04 「现成的 spec：删病人和删账号、它们保留的记录、删除事件和任务事件，以及没有删所有病人的控件」 Existing specs: patient and account delete, the trail they keep, the removal and task events, and no delete-every-patient control

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Completing a task and deleting a task are separate actions, and each is logged as its own analytics event (task completed / task deleted), one per tap, against the chart.（UAT TC-24；UAT OAT-06 item 7；TFA-94514 AC 2）
  • U5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of that patient's data immediately (removed, not hidden), and the audit log is kept.（UAT TC-24；TFA-92579 AC 2；TFA-94699 AC 4）
  • U9 No bulk delete anywhere in the app: records are deleted one at a time, and there is no 'delete all patients' or similar control.（UAT TC-24；TFA-92579 AC 2；TFA-94700 AC 5；TFA-94699 AC 6）
  • T2 Delete account asks for confirmation once, permanently deletes the account and all of that physician's patient data (reusing the patient hard delete), keeps the audit log, and signs out.（TFA-94700 AC 4）
  • T4 Deleting a patient is logged as one 'patient removed' analytics event with the removal reason and the care setting, in both modes.（TFA-94514 AC 1；UAT OAT-06 item 2）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Tim's chromium and api fixtures: one Hospital chart; a physician with patients in every table and a colleague; a fresh signed-in account

When Run the ten tests below unchanged, matched by title

Then forms.spec: removing a patient asks first, a dismiss keeps it, an accept removes the card and rounding:list no longer returns it; Settings has Delete account and no way to delete every patient. audit.spec: a chart delete writes a PHI_WRITE row. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in the named files. What they do not show: forms.spec 'asks first, and the patient survives a cancel' passes only with a native window.confirm (it listens with page.once('dialog')), so it does not support TFA-92579 AC 7 and must change when AC 7 ships; 'confirming removal…' checks rounding:list only, not a hard delete (S03 reads the tables). …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
